Walmart's net income in fiscal Q4 2024 (the quarter ended January 31, 2024) was about $5,494 million. I derived it by subtracting the nine-month figure from the full-year figure, since the excerpts give no standalone Q4 income statement.

I took "net income" to mean consolidated net income attributable to Walmart:

- Fiscal 2024 full year: $15,511 million.
- Nine months ended October 31, 2023: $10,017 million.
- Q4 = 15,511 − 10,017 = $5,494 million.

Including the noncontrolling interest, consolidated net income for the quarter would be $5,678 million (16,270 − 10,592).
